events.title: How to Close Deals & Negotiate
events.full_description: Master corporate communication tactics, strategic negotiation skills, and closing deal techniques for student leaders and entrepreneurs. This immersive event covers everything from initial stakeholder contact to final contract execution.

speakers.name: Marwan Saleh
speakers.bio: Leading global sales initiatives, Marwan specializes in high-stakes contract negotiations and cross-border partnership agreements.

speakers.name: Salma Hassan
speakers.bio: Advises top-tier firms on the legal frameworks of corporate negotiations, ensuring airtight contracts and mutually beneficial terms.

speakers.name: Abdullah Hamed
speakers.bio: Experienced businessman with 10 years of closing deals between B2B companies alongside 3 years of recent expertise in negotiating deals with customers reaching challenging objectives in B2C corporations.

speakers.name: Tarek Youssef
speakers.bio: Focuses on strategic enterprise acquisitions and has successfully mentored over 50 startups in closing their seed funding rounds.

speakers.name: Nourhan Ali
speakers.bio: With over 8 years in public relations, Nourhan expertly navigates stakeholder communication and brand messaging during critical deal closures.

speakers.name: Mona Adel

speakers.name: Laila Mahmoud

speakers.name: Omar Zaki
speakers.bio: Leverages advanced predictive algorithms to solve real-world industry problems, bridging the gap between raw data and actionable AI solutions.

speakers.name: Seif El-Din
speakers.bio: Assists competing teams with deploying their applications instantly to the cloud, ensuring their live demos run without a hitch.

speakers.name: Hala Mounir

speakers.name: Rami Fouad

events.title: How to Present Your Ideas
events.short_description: Learn presentation skills, how to present your ideas across an audience...
events.full_description: Learn presentation skills, how to present your ideas across an audience, and the confidence to speak and pitch technical projects effectively. Perfect for final-year students preparing for graduation projects.

speakers.name: Farida Gomaa
speakers.bio: Dedicated to helping STEM students translate complex technical jargon into compelling narratives that captivate non-technical audiences.

speakers.name: Amr Hesham

speakers.name: Yasmine Tarek

speakers.name: Khaled Omar

speakers.name: Nadia Fathy
speakers.bio: Focuses on the visual storytelling aspect of presentations, showing students how to design slides that highlight their core message.

events.short_description: A quick talk about the future of the Fintech industry...

speakers.bio: Ensures that financial software architectures adhere strictly to global security standards and anti-money laundering (AML) laws.

speakers.name: Hazem Shawky

events.title: Technology Advancements in the Healthcare Industry
events.short_description: Specialised physicians and surgeons highlight the importance of tech...

speakers.name: Ahmed El-Sayed

speakers.name: Dr. Sherif Amin

speakers.name: Nada Samir
